note: Owner, 2026-11-19: a bigger library of things for rivals and bosses to say. Each rival's signature line in its League file (reactions) stays; these add to it. One line is picked at random for each moment, never the same one twice in a row. Moods: entrance (the introduction and the first reaction), confident (an open frame or a gutter), impressed (a strike), threatened (the player near the target), defeated (the player wins), victorious (the rival wins; also the result's parting shot).

entrance: I've staked out this lane to the millimetre.
Bring a level head. I brought a level.
Every board numbered. Every throw recorded.
No curves. No excuses. Only geometry.
The benchmark is set. Try to meet it.
I calibrated the pins this morning. Twice.
Straight lines only. I'll be checking.
confident: Two degrees off. That compounds, you know.
Outside tolerance. Noted in the log.
Your line wandered. Lines shouldn't wander.
That's not a line. That's a suggestion.
I'll mark that one as a rough estimate.
The numbers don't lie. You did miss.
A survey of that throw finds… gaps.
impressed: Square to the deck. I approve.
That's a line I'd put on a map.
Ten for ten. The arithmetic is sound.
Even my instruments agree with that one.
threatened: Your margins are… narrowing mine.
Hm. I may need to re-measure.
Recalculating. Recalculating.
The gap is closing faster than projected.
This wasn't in the survey.
Steady. Steady. Numbers can still change.
I'd like to double-check those figures.
defeated: Measured, verified, beaten. Fair is fair.
I'll file the report. You win.
Your line was truer than mine today.
The figures don't lie. Well rolled.
Survey closed. Lane transferred to you.
I'll recalibrate. You've earned the lane.
Straight and true. I can respect that.
victorious: Measured twice, beaten once. Try again.
My survey stands. Yours needs work.
Off the mark. Precisely as predicted.
Back to the drawing board for you.
A straight line is the shortest path. You took the long one.

entrance: Wipe your feet. This lane's just been done.
I clean up after everyone. Let's see your mess.
Strikes and spares. Anything else is litter.
My broom's ready. Is your arm?
Leave it the way you found it: Empty.
Every pin down, or it's going in the bin.
Spotless lanes, spotless frames. House policy.
confident: That's going straight in the skip.
I'll need the big mop for that one.
Not a clean frame in sight.
impressed: Not a pin out of place. Well, none left.
I couldn't have cleared it better myself.
A clean sheet. I like it.
threatened: Careful… you're making my job easy.
Don't you dare leave a pin standing now.
You're cleaner than I expected.
Hm. Maybe I should have dusted harder.
One mess and it's all mine. One.
You keep this up and I'm out of work.
My broom is trembling.
defeated: Clean as a whistle. The lane is yours.
Not a speck. I hand over the keys.
I'll put the broom away. Well done.
That's the tidiest beating I've had.
Nothing left to sweep. You win.
Fine work. I'll even polish your trophy.
Spotless from start to finish.
victorious: I'll clean up what's left of your score.
Back to the broom cupboard with you.
Messy finish. I've seen worse. Not much.

entrance: Welcome to my alley. Mind the house ball.
My lanes, my ball, my rules. Pull up a chair.
Everybody bowls with the house ball here.
First game's on me. The loss is on you.
The house has been winning since before you were born.
Step right up. The house is open.
You play my way in my place.
confident: Ha! The house thanks you for your business.
That one's going on your tab.
You see? The house knows its lanes.
The house ball does what the house wants.
I'd tip the waiter, but you're doing my job.
impressed: Well now. That's a house record contender.
Even the house ball likes you.
That one goes on the wall.
You'd be good for business, kid.
Fine bowling. I might hire you.
The regulars will talk about that one.
threatened: Easy now. Don't break the house.
That's quite a run you're having in my place.
Someone check the books.
Hey, hey. The house doesn't lose.
I'm starting to regret the free game.
You're getting a little too comfortable.
Who let this one in?
defeated: The house tips its hat. Well played.
Even the house loses once in a while.
I'll put your name on the board.
Drinks are on me tonight.
You beat the house. Don't tell anyone.
My lanes, your win. I'll allow it.
Come back anytime. You're good for the legend.
victorious: Thanks for playing. Tell your friends.
The house ball sends its regards.
Your tab is settled. In my favour.
Come again. The house will be waiting.

entrance: Pull up, kid. Let's bowl like it's 1985.
Wood pins, real lanes, no gimmicks.
I racked these pins before you could walk.
Forget the fancy stuff. Just bowl.
Back in my day we bowled with plain wood. Still do.
Show me what's under all that gear.
Old pins, old lanes, old Lou. Let's go.
confident: Seen that a thousand times. Usually from rookies.
Keep your eye on the arrows.
That's what fancy pins'll do to you.
Steady, kid. Bowling's a long game.
impressed: Ha! That's how we did it in the old days.
Clean as a whistle. Good arm.
That one'd make the old league proud.
You remind me of me. Forty years ago.
Pure wood and pure skill. Lovely.
threatened: Easy, kid. My heart's not what it was.
Where'd you learn to bowl like that?
Hold your horses there.
Huh. Maybe you've got something after all.
I'm getting too old for this.
Who's been coaching you?
Slow down. Let an old man catch up.
defeated: Well, kid. You earned it. Fair and square.
Forty years and still learning. Good game.
Shake an old man's hand. You beat me.
Plain wood and you still won. Respect.
You'll do just fine on these lanes.
Go on, then. The lane's yours. I'll rack 'em.
That's real bowling. I'm proud of you.
victorious: Practise your fundamentals. Then come back.
Keep at it. You'll get there. Maybe.

entrance: Title night. I polished the trophy myself.
Clean frames, house ball. The full inspection.
Champions leave no mess. Let's see if you're one.
The whole House is watching. Mind your manners.
One last sweep before the crown.
confident: That's a mess on title night.
Into the bin it goes. Even tonight.
impressed: Not even the Proprietor could argue that one.
That's the cleanest frame of the night.
threatened: The crown is wobbling…
Steady hands, now. For both of us.
You're cleaning up my title.
No. Not on title night.
One messy frame. That's all I need from you.
defeated: The House has a new champion. A tidy one.
Take the crown. I've dusted it for you.
Spotless to the end. You're the champion.
I hand over the keys to the whole House.
Clean, clear, champion. Well done.
victorious: The title stays clean. Come back tidier.
Not tonight. The House keeps its champion.
Champions don't make messes. You did.
The crown stays with me. Polish your game.

entrance: Fresh coat tonight. Extra shiny.
Hope you brought grip. You'll need it.
Oil's my art form. The lane is my canvas.
Step careful. It's slippery out here.
Curves? Not on my oil, they don't.
I never wipe the lanes. Never.
Smooth operator, smooth lanes.
confident: The oil giveth, the oil taketh away.
That hook went right on vacation.
impressed: You read the oil. Not bad.
You found the dry line. Clever.
Even I couldn't slide that one off.
threatened: Now hold on. My oil's not working.
You're sticking to it… how?
Maybe I need another coat.
Who told you about the dry boards?
Stop reading my lane!
I'm the slippery one here.
This is getting a little too smooth for me.
defeated: Okay. You out-slicked Slick.
The oil bows to you. Take the lane.
Smooth game, friend. You earned it.
Guess I'll go wipe the lanes. Just this once.
You read my oil like a book.
Slick's beaten. Don't spread it around.
All slide, no stick. Well played.
victorious: Slid right out of the match.
The oil wins. The oil always wins.
Come back when you can stand up straight.

entrance: Welcome to the light show. Stay inside the lines.
My beams, my rules. Keep it tight.
Precision or nothing. The lasers are watching.
The gutters are closer than you think.
Let's see you thread a needle of light.
Mind the edges. They glow for a reason.
Bright lights, narrow lanes.
confident: Too wide. The lasers saw it.
Light travels straight. Your ball didn't.
threatened: You're dodging my beams…
Getting a little too accurate there.
Hm. Maybe I need more lasers.
You're glowing a bit too bright for me.
Stop finding the gaps.
This is not how the light show ends.
Steady… steady… don't you dare.
defeated: Laser-perfect. The lane's yours.
You outshone me. Well done.
Lights up for the winner.
Clean through every beam. Impressive.
I'll dim the lights. You earned the spotlight.
Precision beats flash. Respect.
You thread light like a pro.
victorious: The light show's over. You missed it.
Off the beam, out of the match.

entrance: Lights down, volume up. Let's bowl.
Welcome to my set. Keep the beat.
Timing is everything on my floor.
The ring pulses to my track. Can you keep up?
One, two, three, four… release!
This lane's got a BPM. Find it.
Turn it up! Strobes on!
confident: Too early. Or too late. Either way, wrong.
impressed: That one goes on the mixtape.
threatened: Hey, who's running this set?
You're stealing my crowd…
Easy on the rhythm, there.
I might need to change the track.
Too smooth. Way too smooth.
You're on beat and I don't like it.
Okay, now I'm nervous. Turn it down.
defeated: Mic drop. You won the night.
The crowd's chanting your name.
You kept the beat better than me.
Headliner material. Respect.
Lights up. The floor is yours.
That's the best set I've heard all year.
Encore! For you, not me.
victorious: That's a wrap. Better luck next set.
Missed the drop, missed the match.
Practise your timing and come back.
Run it back… when you've got rhythm.

entrance: Headline slot. Biggest night of the year.
Title night: Strobes fast, lanes slick.
The whole of Neon came to hear this set.
Champion's mix. Keep up if you can.
Last track of the League. Make it count.
confident: Title night and you're off-beat? Yikes.
The headliner doesn't wait for you.
Slipped on the oil, missed the drop.
The crowd paid for better than that.
impressed: Even Slick's oil couldn't stop that.
The whole floor felt that one.
threatened: This is MY title night…
You're about to steal the headline.
Don't you dare drop the mic.
Hold the music. Hold it.
The crowd's switching sides.
defeated: New headliner in town. Neon is yours.
Crown and crowd: Both yours.
Best set of the year. And it wasn't mine.
Take a bow, champ. They're cheering for you.
Lights up on the Neon champion.
victorious: Title night's over. Better luck next season.
Come back when you can keep time and grip.

entrance: No freebies in my yard, love.
Pennies don't grow on pins, you know.
My match, my rules: Nobody gets paid.
Keep your hands where I can see them. And your coins.
Every point's free. Everything else costs.
I'll take the till. You take your chances.
Let's see what you score with empty pockets.
confident: Wasted effort. I won't pay for that.
I'd charge you for that one if I could.
Frugal, I am. Foolish, you are.
impressed: Points for nothing. Lovely to see.
Didn't cost you a penny. Clever.
Ooh. Rich in skill, if nothing else.
Worth every coin you didn't spend.
Hm. You might be worth investing in.
threatened: Now, don't get greedy.
You're spending my patience.
Points add up, don't they? Drat.
Who's counting? Oh, I am. Badly.
This is costing me sleep.
Easy there. Some of us are saving.
Stop it. You're bankrupting me.
defeated: Fine. Take your clear. It's on the house. This once.
Beaten for free. That stings.
You earned it. Don't expect change.
Well spent, love. Well spent.
Take it. Mind you don't waste it.
Cheapest loss I've ever had. Ouch.
I'll write it off as a loss.
victorious: Saved my money and my lane.
Come back when you're richer. In skill.
That's how you penny-pinch a victory.
Back to saving, then. Off you go.

entrance: Smell that? That's character.
Ten pins and forty years of grime.
Don't touch the pins. You'll ruin the patina.
A little dirt never hurt anyone. Much.
Welcome to the grimiest lane in the yard.
Polish is for people with nothing to hide.
Gunk, grease and glory. Let's bowl.
impressed: Oh, that cut right through the gunk.
Who needs polish? Not you, apparently.
threatened: Here, don't you scrub my lane.
You're clearing my pins too fast.
Is that… soap I smell?
My grime's losing its grip.
Stop shining up the place.
That's a lot of score for dirty pins.
You're making me look clean, and I hate it.
defeated: Fine. You can polish one. Just one.
Beaten by a clean player. Disgusting.
You dug through the grime and won.
The muck bows to you.
Take the lane. Mind the sludge.
Even grime knows when it's beaten.
Dirty pins, fair fight. You won.
victorious: Back to the dirt with you.
Come back with a stronger stomach.
Leave your polish at the door next time.

entrance: Everything's scrap eventually. Even you.
Bolted-on bits? Not in my match.
Welcome to the scrapyard. Leave your mods at the gate.
Strip it down. Let's see the real bowler.
Rust never sleeps. Neither do I.
I can smell fresh paint. Not for long.
Bare metal only. House rule.
confident: One more for the scrap heap.
Strip the mods and what's left? That.
threatened: Your bare bones are beating my rust…
How are you still rolling?
I need a bigger wrench.
That's not supposed to work without mods.
You're tougher than you look.
My scrapyard's getting cleaned out.
Stop it. You're making rust look bad.
defeated: Solid work. The yard's yours.
Couldn't scrap you if I tried.
Built like a tank. Well played.
Take the lane. And my best wrench.
No mods, no problem. You won.
You're the first thing I couldn't rust.
Good build. I'll salvage my pride.
victorious: You fell apart in the end.
Back to the workshop. Weld better.

entrance: Title night in the yard. Everything gets stripped.
Rust and grime: A champion's welcome.
Biggest scrap heap of the year tonight.
The Salvage crown is made of scrap. Earn it.
Last match. Let's see what survives.
confident: Rusty and dull. Not champion stuff.
That's scrap, not a title throw.
The yard keeps what's left of that.
Grime got you on title night.
impressed: That survived the rust and the grime. Wow.
Rust, grit, grime… and you still struck.
threatened: The crown's starting to rattle…
You can't be winning with nothing on.
My title's rusting away.
Somebody get me a bigger wrench.
Not the crown. Not tonight.
defeated: The yard has a new boss. A sturdy one.
Crown's yours. Keep it oiled.
Nothing left to strip. You win the title.
Champion of the scrapyard. Well built.
The Salvage title goes to the toughest. You.
victorious: Come back with something that lasts.
You fell to pieces at the finish.
